starting_procedures: Restore both E9 bootstrap/self-applied and E11 conventional-meta controllers with source identities and checkpoint hashes. No procedure retraining or selection uses E17. Fixed learning rates 0.001, 0.003 and 0.01 are all reported; no best-rate selection is called an agent capability.
learner: A student and both optimizer moments persist for all 2,048 updates, including context changes. A context vector is the EMA of observed input/output cross-moments including an intercept. Predict using the preceding context state before observing this batch's outputs. Then train once on current examples plus a uniform sample of bounded reservoir replay. Store the context attached to each observed example. Reservoir sampling, data and model initialization have separate deterministic RNGs. No true context, boundary, clean output or future observation is supplied to updates.
stream: Four hidden regimes recur with uniformly sampled segment lengths from 16 to 64 batches and no immediate regime repeat. Conflicting-functions changes the nonlinear function with an unchanged input distribution. Input-shift changes the input mean with one fixed nonlinear function. Worlds, lengths, observations and noise are paired across all arms; teacher data are generated independently of the controller replicate. Context moments, replay, student parameters and optimizer steps never reset between segments.
evaluation: Report every segment's observed and clean prequential MSE, first/final four-batch error, and censored recovery. Recovery is the first completion of three consecutive clean normalized-MSE batches at or below 0.2, with denominator that batch's mean squared clean target plus 0.01. This evaluation-only threshold and clean target do not affect learning. Failure to recover is censored at the actual segment end, never excluded. Recurrence labels are evaluation-only. No claim that reacquisition equals retained competence.
preflight: Verify zero-output learned controller exactly equals fixed Adam, deterministic repeat equality, initial predictions precede the current labels, replay boundedness, unchanged procedure tensors and exact update/forward counters. Frozen learner state must persist through a marked boundary, with global optimizer step increasing rather than resetting.
costs: Record student, controller and optimizer/replay/context tensor bytes, student forward examples, controller forward calls, replay sampling, update counts and local wall time. Persist complete learner and RNG state after each arm. Link inherited E9/E11 bootstrap and self/meta-trial costs separately; no free trained controller. The three fixed arms are reused across controller replicates for identical stream seeds, with inherited/new work separated. These are model-example counts, not complete FLOPs, process RAM or energy.
falsification: If reset-task-trained controllers lose their advantage, harm recovery or fail to beat the equal-meta control on persistent students, E9's bounded self-application does not transfer to this necessary continual-learning setting. Gains that cost more inference are not by themselves efficient autonomous improvement. More training cannot be credited as a novel recursive mechanism.
scope: A fresh stream transfer test of existing procedures, not a newly self-modifying agent. Procedure weights stay fixed here while student and experience state persist. There is no world model, closed-loop agency, semantic memory compression, general reasoning or novelty claim. This tests a missing boundary before investing in an integrated procedure learner.
